candidates.name: Hypothesis
candidates.use: Property and state-machine test patterns for ledgers, gates, resumability, and artifact contracts.
candidates.guardrail: Keep it in test scope; do not add runtime authority. License compatibility must be reviewed before vendoring.

candidates.name: TripoSR
candidates.use: Local image-to-3D candidate suited to the available 8 GB GPU envelope.
candidates.guardrail: No weight download or output promotion without operator approval, provenance, license evidence, and measured geometry/texture gates.

candidates.name: MaterialX
candidates.use: Portable material contracts and validation between Blender, Unreal, and DCC review artifacts.
candidates.guardrail: Prefer engine/DCC bindings already shipped locally; do not build or install a duplicate stack by default.

candidates.name: OpenUSD
candidates.use: Scene, hierarchy, metadata, and interchange contracts for Blender-to-Unreal production.
candidates.guardrail: Use audited Blender/Unreal USD integrations first; avoid a source build unless a measured gap requires it.

candidates.name: meshoptimizer
candidates.use: Deterministic GLB optimization, LOD, and geometry budget measurement for review and interchange assets.
candidates.guardrail: Use as a confined sidecar and compare against Unreal Nanite/import behavior before adoption.

candidates.name: Unreal MCP Automation Bridge
candidates.use: Typed native automation patterns for Blueprint, PCG, asset, and editor operations.
candidates.guardrail: Dimwit's existing bridge stays authoritative; adapt typed contracts only after command-by-command permission review.

candidates.name: Blender MCP
candidates.use: Reference for Blender scene-inspection and typed DCC workflows.
candidates.guardrail: Do not import arbitrary Python execution, background socket authority, telemetry, downloads, or paid-service paths.

candidates.name: TRELLIS
candidates.use: High-quality text/image-to-3D research candidate beyond the current lightweight local lane.
candidates.guardrail: Hold pending per-submodule license audit, storage review, and measured GPU feasibility.

candidates.name: OpenTelemetry Python
candidates.use: Optional traces and metrics around long-running studio jobs.
candidates.guardrail: Dimwit's append-only receipts remain authoritative; telemetry must default to local/no-export.

candidates.name: DVC
candidates.use: Large model/data lineage if Dimwit's artifact volume outgrows its current manifest and Git LFS controls.
candidates.guardrail: Adopt only after a measured provenance gap; no remotes or uploads without operator approval.

candidates.name: MLflow
candidates.use: Optional experiment analytics if local ledger/reporting becomes insufficient.
candidates.guardrail: No tracking server or daemon by default; avoid duplicating Dimwit's proof ledger.
